t.TITANIUM_DIOXIDE.agn: In the EU it is allowed as a UV filter at up to 25% (Annex VI, entry 27; nano form 27a) and as a colourant (CI 77891, Annex IV). The powder form containing particles smaller than 10 µm may not be used in applications that can be inhaled; loose face powder is limited to 25% and hair spray to 1.4% (Annex III, entry 321). In food (E171) it is banned in the EU; the cosmetic authorisation is separate.
t.TITANIUM_DIOXIDE.eff.0: Classified as a suspected carcinogen when inhaled as a powder; this class applies only to exposure by inhalation, not to products applied to the skin.
t.TITANIUM_DIOXIDE.reg.0: EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex III, entry 321: Restricted substance: upper limits and conditions of use depend on the product type.
t.TITANIUM_DIOXIDE.reg.1: EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex VI, entry 27: Permitted UV filter, with an upper limit.
t.TITANIUM_DIOXIDE.reg.2: EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex VI, entry 27a: Permitted UV filter, with an upper limit. (Nano form.)
t.TITANIUM_DIOXIDE.reg.3: EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex IV, entry 143: Permitted colourant.
t.TITANIUM_DIOXIDE.summary: A white mineral pigment and mineral UV filter.
t.TITANIUM_DIOXIDE.what: Reflects and scatters UV rays; gives the product whiteness and coverage.
